preconditions: Explicit SRX program and owned JSON-only context.
steps: Evaluate supported operators in documented order; check strict types, Missing and Boolean short circuit.
Evaluate any/all/none in array order using lexical item binding, strict Boolean predicates and empty-array identities.
Evaluate exact add/subtract/multiply/divide, nested arithmetic and arithmetic inside a quantifier using explicit numeric policy and Appendix U decision vectors.
Run the versioned positive, negative, boundary and error vectors through public SRX APIs; compare exact values, Missing and structured diagnostic locations.

oracle.requirement_contract: SRX 1.0 MUSS mindestens die Operatoren `literal`, `field`, `exists`, `not`, `and`, `or`, `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte`, `in`, `contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`, `length`, `count`, `any`, `all`, `none`, `add`, `subtract`, `multiply` und `divide` definieren.
oracle.scope: Core literal/field, Boolean/comparison, collection, quantifier and exact arithmetic operators over supplied SRX contexts, including versioned conformance and Appendix U numeric vectors. This library scope does not establish every public command consumer or complete live-context integration.

open_items: Public query/filter consumers (8.b) and document query/table consumers (11.f) still need their planned integration evidence against selected model contexts and effective policies. Existing operator and validation-adapter coverage is not full consumer or release evidence.
